cases.title: The pending change an automation proposes reads as the rule's: origin AUTOMATION, the rule id, the owner as maker, and readable Changes rows ("Invoices" = the invoice number)
cases.steps: South customer (Collection POC sam) with invoice 6200; admin MANUAL INVOICE rule (id:eq:I) CREATE_PROMISE amount FIELD Invoice.Balance, linkRecord; run; sam GET /api/approvals/{pc}
cases.expected: PRD B2 + DESIGN §6.11 / TRIAGE r2 APP-R2-1: status PENDING, origin AUTOMATION, ruleId = rule, requestedBy = admin, amount 6200; changes has a row field invoiceIds labelled "Invoices" whose proposedText is the invoice number; no row labelled "Invoice ids"/"Promise ids"; no promiseIds row (a create with none); canApprove true for sam

cases.title: A held automation promise keeps its co-assignees: once another approver applies it, the promise has them
cases.steps: South customer (Collection POC sam) with invoice 7300; a South staff user "coas" (MANAGE/ALL South); admin MANUAL INVOICE rule CREATE_PROMISE FIELD Invoice.Balance, assignees [USER coas, COLLECTION_POC@CUSTOMER]; run -> held; sam approves; GET /api/promises/{id}
cases.expected: DESIGN §5.11 "Promise co-assignees survive a hold" + BE-19 AutomationHoldTest: one promise of 7300 with origin via approval; its assignees include coas and sam (the primary Collection POC)

cases.title: A held outcome is done once: running the ONCE_PER_RECORD rule again while (and after) its change is rejected makes no second pending change
cases.steps: South customer with invoice 6400; admin MANUAL rule CREATE_PROMISE FIXED 6000 ONCE_PER_RECORD; run 1 -> held; run 2; sam rejects; run 3; count pending changes for the customer
cases.expected: DESIGN §5.10 ("A Held outcome is recorded as effect DONE, result_type PENDING_CHANGE, with its dedupe key"): run 1 done 1 (PENDING_CHANGE); runs 2 and 3 done 0 / skipped 1; exactly one pending-change row for the customer (REJECTED after the reject); no promise
cases.actual: {"runs":["SUCCEEDED:d1/s0/f0","SUCCEEDED:d0/s1/f0","SUCCEEDED:d0/s1/f0"],"pc":3,"reject":[200,"REJECTED"],"pendingRows":["3/REJECTED"],"promises":0,"effects2":[["SKIPPED","Already done for this record"]],"effects3":[["SKIPPED","Already done for this record"]]}

cases.title: Every automation event the consumer wrote in this run has its counters set (MIG-R2-1 column defaults) and none is left unprocessed
cases.steps: SQL on e2e_automation: column defaults of automation_events.depth/claims; count rows with null counters; count rows not DONE/SKIPPED/CANCELLED older than 2 minutes
cases.expected: TRIAGE r2 B1 (MIG-R2-1): depth and claims default 0; no null counters; nothing stuck

cases.title: The approver opens a change an automation proposed: "Raised by" links the rule, and the Changes tab names the invoice by number
cases.steps: South customer (Collection POC sam) with invoice 6600; admin MANUAL rule CREATE_PROMISE FIELD Invoice.Balance; run -> held; sam opens /approvals/{pc}
